summary: A list from which one option, or several, can be chosen. It is a form control and one stop in the Tab order.

value.description: The value of the selected option. With multiple, the selected values separated by commas.

multiple.description: More than one option can be selected.

name.description: The name the value is submitted under; with multiple, once per selected option.

required.description: The form cannot be submitted while nothing is selected.

disabled.description: It cannot be chosen or focused.

root.note: A frame padded like a menu, with its options stacked inside.

thumb.note: The tint of the highlighted option, the row the keys point at, while the listbox has focus: the tint of a row under the pointer. It takes the box of the highlighted option, its anchor, and moves to the next one highlighted (C32); it scrolls with the options and is clipped to the frame. A selected option's own face covers it. Drawn as a pseudo-element, so it is in place before the elements are defined.

keys.ArrowDown, ArrowUp: Move to the next or the previous option. In a single listbox that selects it.
keys.Home, End: Move to the first or the last option.
keys.Space: With multiple: selects the option, or clears it.
keys.A letter: Moves to the next option that starts with it.

events.input: Dispatched when the user changes the selection.

guidance.text: The author names the listbox with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Write `selected` on the selected option, so that it is painted before the listbox is defined.

notYet: Selecting a range with Shift, and all with Control+A.
